name: Goblin armored warband
source: Approved concepts in Design three goblin variants, 2026-10-01
gameplay: Ordinary battle pool, existing vocabulary challenges, room-scaled HP, damage and rewards. No special stat bonuses.
states: One approved full-body pose per enemy. Melee translation, hit recoil, defeat rotation/fade; Shaman remains at range and casts a renderer-drawn projectile. Not a multi-pose animation sheet.
reducedMotion: No translations, tilts, collapse or projectiles; static damage UI and defeat fade remain.
draw: Full 1254-square source rect; feet anchored at canvas y=347; visible height 116px (26% smaller). Shaman mirrored at draw time to face hero; source PNG unchanged.
saves: Roster 1 regenerates with original six IDs in frozen order. Pre-roster saves retain original variant-only encounters. New runs use roster 2.
audio: Existing correct-answer and retaliation cues, mute and volume preferences retained.
revision: Simplified approved artwork: removed rust, scratches, skin spots and excess rivets; broader color regions. Reduced dungeon height from 156 to 116px. Spell origin uses the same scale.
